promotion_rules.ci_to_runtime: all runtime and supply-chain runtime gates require immutable evidence refs bound to exact source SHA; public-repository runtime runners must also prove ephemeral/JIT single-job isolation
promotion_rules.cloudflare_connection_to_discovery: requires active account-scoped token, valid account id, jadeltechrd.com zone read, Tunnel API read, R2 API read and GET-only exact target-state discovery
promotion_rules.cloudflare_discovery_to_change_ready: requires one manual exact-SHA execution proving GitHub-hosted runner, Tailscale OIDC WIF path and expected tag, exact Kubernetes context/namespace, absence of cluster-admin and Secret-read rights, immutable cloudflared digest, Secrets Store CSI CRD/schema admission, network-policy contract, runner-side Cloudflare 7844 precheck, dedicated R2 parent credential presence, temporary-credential mint plan, bucket-lock plan and rollback plan while Cloudflare writes remain disabled
promotion_rules.cloudflare_change_ready_to_creation: requires a separate explicit human confirmation and create-only idempotent workflow; deletes, overwrite of pre-existing nonmatching resources and first-change DNS mutation remain forbidden
promotion_rules.cloudflare_creation_to_post_create: requires actual target resources plus Bucket Lock, Tunnel token stored in OpenBao, real CSI mount, real runtime-path 7844 connectivity, functional R2 parent credential, temporary R2 credential mint, digest-pinned cloudflared deployment and healthy replicas
promotion_rules.cloudflare_post_create_to_runtime_verifi: requires R2 checksum roundtrip, overwrite/delete denial during lock, tunnel failover, credential rotation, OTel evidence and exact-SHA evidence binding
promotion_rules.runtime_to_production: requires separate safety, quality, SLO, DR and sustained-operation evidence
